reasoning_content:
Good — LazyBrowser is lazy (it's only launched on demand for PDFs). So the server should work fine without Chromium, as long as PDF generation isn't required.

Next, how does `/api/:tenant/...` resolve the tenant parameter? Let me look for the authorization module and the place where the tenant parameter gets converted into a tenant ID. I'll search for `authorize(` in the service directory.

action.command: cd /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend && ls src/commons/services/ | head -30; grep -rln "authorize" src/commons/services/authorization* 2>/dev/null; find src -name "authorization*" -o -name "*auth*.js" | grep -i common | head
